events.title: DefCamp Capture the Flag (D-CTF) 2026 Quals
events.description: Mark Your Calendars! The DefCamp Capture the Flag (D-CTF) Qualification Phase is Locked and Loaded for 2026! Get ready to dive into the most electrifying and audacious security CTF competition in Central and Eastern Europe—DefCamp Capture The Flag (D-CTF)! This is where the sharpest hackers and IT masterminds come together to push their skills to the limit, battling it out with top CTF teams from around the globe. The mission? Secure a spot in the elite top 10 and ultimately conquer the D-CTF competition—or go down fighting! Since 2011, DefCamp Capture the Flag has been the ultimate battleground for over 10,000 players. This annual, multi-stage event is open to all, but remember one crucial rule—hack or be hacked! Event Highlights Brace yourselves for an adrenaline-packed adventure with around 10 beginner-friendly challenges and 15 more difficult tasks that will test even the most seasoned players. Format: Jeopardy Play Format: Team-only Genres: Crypto, Pwning, Reversing, Web, Forensics, Miscellaneous… Language: English Access: Open / Free for everyone Difficulty: Entry Level - Easy - Medium - Hard - Insane The Challenge Awaits Tackle a variety of challenges across multiple categories. Exploit system weaknesses, follow cryptic hints, and uncover hidden secrets. Each challenge holds a unique flag in the format CTF{sha256 random message}. Capture it, submit it on our platform, and rack up your points. CTF competitions are a thrilling mix of puzzles and challenges, including reverse-engineering, memory corruption, cryptography, web tech, and more. Solve them, capture the flag, and climb the leaderboard to victory! Organizers & Partners This epic event is brought to you by the Cyber Security Research Center from Romania (Asociatia Centrul de Cercetare in Securitate Informatica din Romania) under the banner of DefCamp, Romania's largest and most vibrant INFOSEC community.

events.title: WATCHLIST
events.description: WATCHLIST is a 24-hour online Jeopardy CTF about digital investigation: forensics, OSINT, recon, and the hands-on work investigators actually do. It's a love letter to Person of Interest, narrated by The Machine. There are 24 challenges across 6 categories: Forensics, Lab, OSINT, Recon, Trivia, and a Person of Interest story track that unlocks as you play. It's made for beginners through intermediate players, so there's an easy way in and the difficulty climbs from there. Every challenge teaches a real, usable skill with tools people actually use, and the hints are written to teach you something, not just hand over the answer. A few quick things: Any tools are fine, including AI. They're helpers, not shortcuts, and they won't finish a challenge for you. Teams of 1 to 6, and solo players are very welcome. Free to play. Prizes: $750 / $500 / $250 for the top three. When: 19 September 2026, 03:30 UTC. Runs for 24 hours. Briefing: https://xposedornot.com/ctf Platform: https://ctf.xposedornot.com Discord: https://discord.com/invite/X5DtMQgbdP Updates: https://x.com/@watchlistctf on X

events.title: Hacker's Gambit 2026 (Round 1 – Online Qualifier)
events.description: Round 1 – Online Qualifier (48 Hours) The Online Qualifier is the first stage of Hackers Gambit 2026, designed to identify the most skilled cybersecurity teams from around the world. This 48-hour Jeopardy-style Capture The Flag (CTF) competition will challenge participants with a diverse set of real-world cybersecurity problems across multiple domains. Participants will solve challenges in areas including Web Security, Cryptography, Reverse Engineering, Digital Forensics, Binary Exploitation (Pwn), Open Source Intelligence (OSINT), Steganography, and Miscellaneous. Each challenge carries a predefined score based on its difficulty level, and teams earn points by successfully capturing and submitting valid flags. The competition will run continuously for 48 hours, allowing teams to strategize, collaborate, and solve challenges at their own pace within the competition window. A live leaderboard will be available throughout the event (subject to organizer discretion). At the conclusion of the qualifier, participating teams may be required to submit technical write-ups explaining their solutions to selected challenges. These submissions will be reviewed by the organizing committee to verify the authenticity of solutions and ensure fair play. Based on the final scores, write-up evaluation (if applicable), and adherence to the competition rules, the Top 15 teams will qualify for the 24-hour Offline Grand Finale at Jaihind College of Engineering, Kuran, where they will compete for the championship title, prizes, and recognition. Key Highlights Mode: Online Duration: 48 Hours Format: Jeopardy-style Capture The Flag (CTF) Challenge Categories: Web Security, Cryptography, Reverse Engineering, Digital Forensics, Binary Exploitation, OSINT, Steganography, and Miscellaneous Qualification: Top 15 teams advance to the Offline Grand Finale Time: 2 October 2026 (12:00 PM IST) – 4 October 2026 (12:00 PM IST)

events.title: EyesOpenCTF 7th edition
events.description: EyesOpenCTF 2026 is a FREE CTF competition organized as part of the 7th edition of EOCON. This year, the competition goes far beyond a traditional CTF. You are not simply joining to solve isolated challenges. You are entering The Convergence, a live 48-hour cyber adventure in which reality itself is beginning to fracture. Across more than 40 challenges and 8 disciplines, teams will investigate corrupted systems, recover hidden Reality Fragments, unlock classified dossiers, expose compromised actors, and gradually reconstruct the truth behind a phenomenon threatening the entire world. Every flag matters. Each solved challenge can reveal new intelligence, unlock characters and locations, alter the mission briefing, and move the story forward in real time. The competition platform becomes a living investigation that evolves with the progress of the Operators. Expect : - web exploitation, - digital forensics, - reverse engineering, - binary exploitation, - cryptography, - OSINT, - AI security, and more—woven into a single coherent mission unlike any previous EyesOpenCTF. Built for teams from around the world and open to different experience levels, EyesOpenCTF is both a proving ground and an immersive narrative experience where competitors can learn, compete, get noticed, and join a fast-growing international cybersecurity community. As part of EOCON, the competition also connects participants with experts, researchers, recruiters, entrepreneurs, and emerging talent from Africa and beyond. It is a place where technical ability meets storytelling, where discoveries change the mission, and where tomorrow’s collaborations, careers, and opportunities begin. Form your team. Enter the Protocol. Recover the Fragments.
